terminal-colours.reason: Import from Ghostty writes background, foreground, cursor, cursor text and all sixteen palette slots as Orca colour overrides.

terminal-selection.reason: Import from Ghostty writes the selection background and foreground overrides.

pane-divider.reason: Import from Ghostty writes split-divider-color to Orca's dark and light divider colours.

terminal-font.reason: Import from Ghostty writes the terminal font family and size (px).

terminal-line-height.reason: Orca keeps its own line height and letter spacing.

light-mode.reason: The theme has no light profile. Orca's colour overrides apply whatever terminal theme is selected, so they are a dark theme in either mode.

outside-terminal.reason: Layout geometry, fonts outside the terminal and trust/approval dialogs remain host-owned; the plugin sets only public colour tokens.

app-chrome.reason: Orca 1.4.246 data theme tokens colour the application, sidebars, settings and structured agent views. Trust and approval dialogs remain host-owned.

code-editor.reason: App theme editor-surface and TextMate tokenColors colour the editor and supported code previews.

shell-prompt.reason: Generated agnoster variables set prompt surfaces and ordinary text from canonical terminal prompt roles; status icons retain semantic colors.

browser-loading.reason: Installed Orca 1.4.246 uses bg-callout-note for the address progress bar and hardcoded text-blue-500 for tab loading spinners and fallback icons. Neither color is exposed by the public app-theme token contract.

tooltips.reason: Installed Orca 1.4.246 tooltips invert foreground/background; no separate tooltip token is exposed. Setting foreground black would hide ordinary app text.

app-text-selection.reason: Shared inputs use primary/primary-foreground; plain prose and explicit system Highlight selections remain host-owned.
